detailed_descriptions.en: What was once a place of rest has become a pulsating hive of insects, flesh, and decay, buried beneath a forest that swallows the light. Visceral Action-Horror FPS A methodical descent into nightmare. Brutal Close-Range Combat Tear through infested horrors with weighty weapons, crushing impacts, and brutal dismemberment. Oppressive Horror Environments Suffocating forest and desecrated crypts consumed by infestation. A Descent into Suffocating Darkness Explore crypts where visibility is scarce, every sound matters, and danger crawls just beyond your flashlight. Hear the Horror Before You See It Skittering sounds, distant screeches, and oppressive silence turn every corridor into a threat.
